MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 64
   D. 32

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

4. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

10. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 55
   C. 16
   D. 22

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

13. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 100
   C. 11
   D. 10

14. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 75
   C. 30
   D. 20

16. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

17. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

18. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

19. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

20. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

21. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

23. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12.5
   C. 6
   D. 25

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 46
   B. 30
   C. 23
   D. 120

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
